compiled_state.title: llm-review: large-diff Strategy F path returns non-JSON LLM output -> CI job cancelled, no findings recorded
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 21c8c077d4b830de2439e4e49f3bfbf451c7c5b4
* **PR:** https://github.com/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra/pull/345 (worktree-20260524-135547 -> main; epic 4047-3cb1-6cb4-46a1 finalize)
* **PR scale:** 99 files changed, +12,609 / -4,936 lines (~18,600-line diff)
* **CI workflow:** `.github/workflows/ci.yml` job `llm-review`
* **Reviewer dispatch:** `plugins/dso/scripts/llm-review-dispatch-or-skip.sh` -> `runner.py`
* **Strategy activated:** Strategy F (file-filter + chunked + aggregated review) — triggered because diff exceeds the region-split threshold
* **Failing agent:** `code-reviewer-deep-correctness` (primary model: `claude-opus-4-7`)
* **Failed CI run id:** 26415787344 (job 77762612379)

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** Sub-Agent Blocker (CI tooling cannot complete LLM review on a real-world large PR)

#### Expected Behavior

Per the deep-tier CI review contract (`plugins/dso/docs/CI-INTEGRATION.md` + `plugins/dso/docs/workflows/REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md`), the llm-review job should run all 3 deep-tier specialist sub-agents (correctness, verification, hygiene) and the arch synthesizer against the PR diff and write findings to `/tmp/findings.json` consumed by `mirror-defenses-to-pr.sh`. The Strategy F large-diff path (file-filter + chunked + aggregated) is the documented mechanism for handling diffs that exceed the region-split threshold, and it MUST either (a) produce a parseable findings JSON, or (b) escalate explicitly so the PR is not silently un-reviewed.

#### Actual Behavior

The llm-review job activated Strategy F, dispatched `code-reviewer-deep-correctness` on `claude-opus-4-7`, received a 134,457-character response that was not valid JSON, exhausted the fallback chain, and was then cancelled (likely by a subsequent push that superseded the run, but the cancellation came AFTER the parse failure). The PR was left with `mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED` on a missing llm-review SUCCESS status, with no findings recorded.

Verbatim from the CI log (`gh run view 26415787344 --log --job 77762612379`):

```
2026-05-25T19:34:11Z INFO: diff exceeds region-split threshold — activating Strategy F file-filter + chunked + aggregated review
2026-05-25T19:34:11Z WARNING: review.large_diff.ignore.glob empty; consider defaults
2026-05-25T19:53:35Z ERROR: LLM returned non-JSON response (length=134457); cannot parse as findings.
2026-05-25T19:53:35Z ERROR: LLM returned non-JSON response (length=134457); cannot parse as findings.
2026-05-25T19:53:35Z Fallback chain exhausted for agent code-reviewer-deep-correctness (primary=claude-opus-4-7): LLM returned non-JSON response (length=134457); cannot parse as findings.
2026-05-25T20:18:56Z ##[error]The operation was canceled.
```

Time-on-failure: ~19 minutes 24 seconds between Strategy F activation and the non-JSON parse error (19:34:11 -> 19:53:35). The job ran another ~25 minutes before cancellation.

### 3. Action History and Workarounds

* **Steps taken in the failing session:**
  * 5 consecutive CI runs against PR #345 (run ids 26415787344, 26415597979, 26415386348, 26415384430, 26412857563) — every run shows `llm-review` cancelled.
  * No alternate dispatch path or smaller-scope re-run was attempted by the CI workflow itself.

* **Workaround used to unblock this PR:** A local deep-tier review was dispatched manually from the orchestrator session against the same diff. Three specialist sub-agents (correctness, verification, hygiene-design) returned structured findings successfully — same diff, same models, no parse failure. The architectural difference is that the local dispatch ran one agent at a time with the diff file path explicit (`/tmp/dso-review-345/diff.patch`) and let the agent read it via Read tool with offset/limit, whereas CI's Strategy F inlines chunks into the prompt.

### 4. Suspected Categories

* **Token-budget exhaustion at the model output:** A 134KB output suggests the model emitted a long narrative response (possibly thinking text or refusal/escape-hatch output that mixed prose with JSON), rather than a structured findings array. The output length is well above the `max_tokens` ceiling typically used for findings JSON.
* **Strategy F prompt may not constrain the model to JSON-only output strongly enough** when the input chunk count is high — the model defaults to a natural-language summary instead of the structured schema.
* **No JSON-parse-failure escalation:** When parse fails, the fallback chain exhausts and the job cancels without a graceful degradation (e.g., file the per-file findings that DID parse, or emit a SKIP signal with rationale and a tag the PR for human review). The current "either full structured findings or nothing" contract is brittle at large-diff scale.
* **Region-split threshold may be set too high** (the diff hit Strategy F as a fallback when chunking the regions would have been a less costly path; review the threshold values in `review.large_diff.*` config).
* **review.large_diff.ignore.glob empty** — the WARNING line suggests there is an unused ignore-glob configuration knob that, if populated with appropriate defaults (snapshots, test fixtures, generated code), would shrink the effective diff size enough to skip Strategy F.

### 5. Skills and Workflows Touched

* `/dso:review` — the deep-tier review skill that this CI job operationalises.
* `plugins/dso/scripts/llm-review-dispatch-or-skip.sh` — the CI entry point.
* `plugins/dso/scripts/llm-review-runner.py` (or equivalent runner) — Strategy F dispatch logic.
* `plugins/dso/docs/CI-INTEGRATION.md` — contract being violated.
* `plugins/dso/docs/workflows/REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md` — local-side equivalent that succeeded.

### 6. Logs and Evidence

* **Full CI log:** `gh run view 26415787344 --log --job 77762612379` (search "Strategy F" / "non-JSON")
* **Local successful dispatch evidence:** During PR #345 finalize, three deep-tier specialist sub-agents (`dso:code-reviewer-deep-correctness`, `dso:code-reviewer-deep-verification`, `dso:code-reviewer-deep-hygiene`) plus the arch synthesizer (`dso:code-reviewer-deep-arch`, opus) ran successfully against the same diff and returned 19 structured findings. The local agents had access to Read for the diff file; the CI Strategy F path inlines the diff.
* **PR scale for repro:** 99 files / +12,609 / -4,936 lines / ~18,600 diff lines. The threshold above which Strategy F activates can be derived from this scale point.

#### Suggested investigation entry points

* `plugins/dso/scripts/` — locate the Strategy F dispatch and the JSON-parse fallback handler.
* `review.large_diff.ignore.glob` / `review.large_diff.region_split.threshold` config keys (the WARNING points at the first).
* Compare the CI Strategy F prompt template vs. the locally-successful agent prompts — the local prompts pass the diff file path; CI inlines chunked content. Whether one yields more structured output than the other under opus is worth profiling.

comments.body: Classification: behavioral, Score: 3 (INTERMEDIATE). Root cause: Strategy F cluster dispatch loop in runner.py ignores oversized_single_file=True flag from region_split.py — oversized file diffs (LOC > loc_threshold) are dispatched to LLM without truncation, causing token budget exhaustion and non-JSON responses from claude-opus-4-7. Fix: emit skip/OVER_BOUND cluster result for oversized_single_file=True specs rather than dispatching to LLM.
